definitions.gloss: to go out; to leave (home); to set out
definitions.explanation: To leave one's current location, typically home, to go somewhere. Often used for casual outings rather than formal departures.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}だった。それでも{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: It was raining. But I went out anyway.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{買|か}い{物|もの}に{出|で}かける。
examples.english: I go out shopping on weekends.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{出|で}かける{約束|やくそく}がある。
examples.english: I have plans to go out with a friend.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}).

ASPECT: {出|で}かけている indicates either 'is going out' (in progress) or 'has gone out/is away' (resultant state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜に{出|で}かける (to go out to ~)
・{買|か}い{物|もの}に{出|で}かける (to go out shopping)
・{遊|あそ}びに{出|で}かける (to go out to have fun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{出|で}る (to leave/exit - more general)
・{外出|がいしゅつ}する (to go out - more formal)
